verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents outbound webhooks that consumers set up by event type (e.g., `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`), with parseable payload fields, a `webhook-id` header for idempotency, and opt-in signing. That is a programmatic event subscription mechanism. Missing for 10: a documented full catalog of subscribable event types, explicit registration API/UI steps and retry/delivery-guarantee policy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Set up a webhook of type `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`
Every webhook we send carries a `webhook-id` header
Webhook signing is opt-in per account.
